name: analyze_network_issues
description:
Analyze the network for potential issues and return a structured report.

Aggregates device health, client connection issues, interference,
firmware status, and recent alarms into an AI-friendly summary.

description: Archive all active alarms.

description: Create a port forwarding rule on the gateway.

description: Delete a network/VLAN by name or ID. Requires confirm=true.

name: delete_port_forward
description: Delete a port forwarding rule. Requires confirm=true.

description: Delete a wireless network (SSID). Requires confirm=true.

description: Export a camera recording clip (MP4) to a local file. Requires Protect credentials.

name: forget_client
description: Remove a client from the known clients list.

description: Get active alarms.

name: get_all_sites_health
description: Get health overview across all sites.

name: get_camera_details
description: Get detailed information about a specific camera.

name: get_camera_health_summary
description:
Get a health summary of all cameras.

Provides an overview of camera status, connectivity, and potential issues.

name: get_camera_snapshot
description:
Get a snapshot from a camera.

Returns a base64-encoded JPEG image.

name: get_client_details
description: Get detailed information about a specific client.

name: get_client_experience_report
description:
Generate a client experience report with connection quality metrics.

Includes signal strength distribution, roaming stats, failed connections,
and problematic clients.

name: get_client_traffic
description: Get traffic statistics for a specific client.

name: get_device_details
description: Get detailed information about a specific device.

name: get_device_health_summary
description:
Summarize device health across all APs, switches, and routers.

Includes uptime, load, memory, temperature, firmware versions,
and devices needing attention.

name: get_device_ports
description: List the switch/gateway ports on a device (index, name, link, speed, VLAN).

name: get_device_stats
description: Get performance statistics for a device.

name: get_dpi_stats
description: Get Deep Packet Inspection statistics for the site.

name: get_firewall_policies
description: Get zone-based firewall policies (UniFi Network 9+).

name: get_firewall_rules
description: Get firewall rule configurations.

name: get_global_client_summary
description:
Get a summary of all connected clients across all controllers.

Aggregates client counts, top talkers, and blocked clients
across the entire infrastructure.

name: get_global_health
description:
Get health summary across all configured controllers.

Collects site health from every network-enabled device and produces
a unified health report with per-device breakdowns.

name: get_global_inventory
description:
Get a unified inventory of all devices across all configured controllers.

Aggregates list_devices from every network-enabled UniFi device.
Use this to see the full picture across gateways, sites, or locations.

name: get_liveviews
description: Get all configured Protect liveviews.

name: get_motion_events
description:
Get recent motion events from cameras.

Requires username and password configured for the Protect device.

name: get_network_health
description: Get overall network health summary.

name: get_networks
description: Get all network/VLAN configurations.

name: get_optimization_recommendations
description:
Analyze network configuration and provide optimization recommendations.

Checks channel selection, TX power, VLAN efficiency, port configurations,
and bandwidth utilization patterns.

name: get_port_forwards
description: Get all port forwarding rules (external port+protocol → internal IP+port).

name: get_port_profiles
description: Get switch port profile configurations.

name: get_protect_accessories
description: Get all Protect accessories (lights, sensors, chimes, viewers).

name: get_protect_event_summary
description:
Get a summary of all Protect events for the time period.

Shows motion count, smart detections breakdown, and doorbell activity.
Requires username and password configured for the Protect device.

name: get_protect_system_info
description: Get UniFi Protect system information including camera and accessory counts.

name: get_recent_events
description: Get recent network events.

name: get_recent_protect_activity
description:
Get recent activity across all cameras.

Provides a quick overview of the most recent events.
Requires username and password configured for the Protect device.

name: get_routing_table
description: Get the current routing table.

name: get_site_health
description: Get comprehensive health status for a site.

name: get_site_settings
description: Get site configuration settings.

name: get_smart_detections
description:
Get smart detection events (person, vehicle, animal, package).

Requires username and password configured for the Protect device.

name: get_speed_test_status
description: Get speed test status and results.

name: get_sysinfo
description: Get system information for the site controller.

name: get_traffic_analysis
description:
Analyze traffic patterns over the specified time period.

Includes top talkers, application breakdown (DPI), bandwidth trends,
and unusual activity.

name: get_traffic_summary
description: Get traffic summary for the site.

name: get_wlans
description: Get all wireless network (SSID) configurations.

description: List all known clients (including offline).

description: List all UniFi Protect cameras with status.

name: list_clients
description: List all currently connected clients.

name: list_devices
description: List all UniFi network devices (APs, switches, routers).

name: list_sites
description: List all UniFi sites accessible to the current user.

name: list_unifi_devices
description:
List all configured UniFi devices.

Shows device names, URLs, and available services (network, protect).
Use the device name with other tools to target specific devices.

name: locate_device
description: Enable/disable LED blinking to locate a device.

name: provision_device
description: Force re-provision a device with current configuration.

name: reserve_client_ip
description: Reserve a device's current IP (or a specific one) via DHCP reservation.

name: restart_device
description: Restart a UniFi device.

name: run_speed_test
description: Initiate a WAN speed test.

name: set_device_port
description: Configure a single switch port: native VLAN, PoE mode, name, or enable state.

name: set_firewall_policy_enabled
description: Enable or disable a zone-based firewall policy.

name: troubleshoot_client
description:
Deep-dive troubleshooting for a specific client.

Includes connection history, signal quality, AP associations,
roaming events, and potential issues.

name: unblock_client
description: Unblock a previously blocked client.

name: update_network
description: Update a network/VLAN by name or ID - only provided fields change.

name: update_wlan
description: Update a wireless network (SSID) by ID or name - only provided fields change.

name: upgrade_device
description: Upgrade device firmware to the latest version.
